item.title: Community members rally for accountability in refugee's death
item.description: BUFFALO, N.Y. (WIVB) -- Chants echoed through the streets of downtown Buffalo on Saturday as hundreds of community members marched into Niagara Square, demanding answers in the death of Nurul Amin Shah Alam. "Alam was intentionally left in harm's way by CBP," said Win Min, a Burmese community organizer. "His blood is on their hands." [...]

item.title: Bisons host annual spring training carnival
item.description: BUFFALO, N.Y. (WIVB) -- The Buffalo Bisons hosted their annual spring training carnival on Sunday at The Powerhouse.
